title: Golden Trinity in Alchemy
description: A surreal painting depicts a three-headed golden figure with multiple arms, covered in text and symbols, seated in a large copper basin filled with molten gold that drips everywhere. The scene is set inside a stone chamber with walls covered in glowing alchemical and esoteric symbols, a skylight above casting radiant beams, and scattered papers on the floor.
prompt: A surreal alchemical scene inside a stone vaulted chamber with walls covered in glowing red and yellow esoteric runes and symbols. At the center, a three-headed golden humanoid figure with multiple arms sits in a large copper basin overflowing with molten glowing gold that drips down the sides and onto the floor. The figure is covered in intricate text and symbols, holding a quill pen in one hand and a book in another, with radiant light beams shining down from a stained glass skylight above. Scattered papers with writing lie on the floor around the basin, dramatic golden hour lighting, highly detailed symbolic painting.
